answer: Each identity files one karst shard in the dune registry and locks a 70-credit bond. Weight, grain, serial recorded once; no two keys file the same karst shard. Each epoch the tide auditor re-measures samples; mismatch or reuse burns the bond. Filing 38, then 38+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 3,035,000, lock 70,000, vs a 40,000 pool. A rented shard carries its owner's tag; borrowing one burns both keys. An honest agent pays 38 once, keeps the bond.
